authority.self_binding_policy: Do not embed the package commit SHA inside the same commit. Bind final Git identity externally in GitHub PR, Jira, and Confluence.

objective.statement: Integrate behavior-neutral, failure-preserving K0 per-stage telemetry into the stacked A1 receipt path, then execute the frozen LegacyFixed six-family matrix with complete accounting.
objective.observable_success: One draft stacked implementation PR contains opt-in K0 telemetry, explicit COMPLETE/STOP_INVALID/ERROR stage and cell receipts, exact checked operator accounting, a complete 2x6 replay, fresh-context review, final differential audit, and synchronized GitHub/Jira/Confluence identities.
non_goals: Changing RODAS5P equations, tolerances, controller, acceptance, requested outputs, or recycle transaction semantics
Shared Krylov, structured initial-guess optimization, homotopy-certificate redesign, timing authority, speedup, ranking, tag, or release
Rewriting historical A1 receipts or treating the K0 prototype as canonical integration evidence

invariants.statement: The public production solver path and default kernel remain byte-semantically legacy; K0 is opt-in receipt-only instrumentation.
invariants.guard: production parity regression plus source-scope diff check

invariants.statement: The unpreconditioned true residual remains the sole linear convergence authority.
invariants.guard: existing true-residual tests plus candidate/legacy focused regressions

invariants.statement: For every stage receipt, operator_applies_total equals checked_add(linear_matvecs, diagnostic_matvecs).
invariants.guard: receipt validator and diagnostic-omission mutation test

invariants.statement: Telemetry must not add an unledgered operator/JVP application; any extra nonlinear-remainder JVP is named telemetry_jvp_overhead.
invariants.guard: counter parity test with telemetry disabled/enabled and explicit overhead assertion

invariants.statement: Every attempted stage and every required matrix cell terminates explicitly as COMPLETE, STOP_INVALID, or ERROR; no failed item is omitted.
The nonlinear remainder is exactly f_i - f_0 - J_n delta_i - c_i h f_t,n under the repository sign convention.
invariants.guard: affine-zero, nonlinear manufactured, and signed vector regression

invariants.statement: The angle diagnostic measures current-RHS novelty against the pre-solve retained/prefix space; nested cumulative-space self-overlap is not used as the sole scalar.
invariants.guard: known 0, pi/2, scale-invariance, and nested-space adversarial tests

invariants.statement: Norm-only telemetry never claims residual-sign coverage; signed residual regression remains a separate mandatory test.
invariants.guard: claim-schema check and sign-mutation negative test

invariants.statement: Rejected or failed attempts restore mutable recycle state exactly as before instrumentation.
The K1 matrix is exactly 2 kernel arms x 6 frozen families under LegacyFixed; incomplete matrices are STOP_INVALID.
invariants.guard: matrix cardinality, identity, tolerance, and family-set validator

invariants.statement: K0 and K1 outputs remain exploratory/non-authoritative and cannot imply wall-time speedup, production safety, or BDF ranking.
GitHub owns source identity, Jira owns work state, and Confluence owns navigation/claim boundaries; cross-plane completion requires matching durable identifiers.

failure_modes.trigger: Instrumentation changes production dispatch, equations, tolerance, acceptance, output, or recycle semantics.

detection.executable: cargo test -p rodas5p-integrators --test k0_stage_telemetry_contracts production_path_is_observationally_identical && python tools/verify-k0-stage-telemetry-plan.py --repo-root . --check-final-diff

failure_modes.trigger: Diagnostic certification apply is excluded from headline operator cost.
failure_modes.consequence: False work reduction and broken accounting authority.

prevention.mechanism: Checked exact total and separate named fields.

failure_modes.trigger: A failed stage or cell is omitted or converted to COMPLETE.

prevention.mechanism: Explicit terminal-state enum and exact identity set.

failure_modes.trigger: Nonlinear remainder formula has a sign, time-derivative, or frozen-Jacobian mismatch.

prevention.mechanism: Equation-to-code test with affine zero and signed nonlinear witness.

failure_modes.trigger: Frozen family/tolerance/kernel identity drifts during replay.

prevention.mechanism: Exact identifiers embedded in every cell and aggregate.

failure_modes.trigger: Telemetry computes a duplicate initial residual operator apply outside the solver.
failure_modes.consequence: The instrument changes the measured economics.

prevention.mechanism: Return private observation metadata from the solver internals.

failure_modes.trigger: Nested cumulative subspaces yield a tautological near-zero angle.
Norm telemetry is presented as residual-sign validation.

prevention.mechanism: Separate signed-vector regression and explicit blind-spot metadata.

failure_modes.trigger: GitHub, Jira, or Confluence identifiers disagree or Atlassian writes are skipped silently.

prevention.mechanism: ATLAS_SYNC_PENDING or BLOCKED_BY_ATLASSIAN_AUTHORITY_DRIFT; never cross-plane PASS.

forbidden_changes: Do not change tolerances, family identities, frozen tau, restart/maxiter, or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not route production callers to telemetry or the incremental-Givens candidate.
Do not delete, weaken, or relabel true-residual certification.
Do not hide telemetry work in existing counter categories.
Do not merge PR #20, retarget it, or rewrite its branch.

github.implementation_pr_policy: Open one draft stacked PR against research/a1-post-a2a3-kernel-rerun; do not merge.

authority_roles.github: source bytes, contracts, commits, PR reviews, evidence manifests
authority_roles.confluence: navigation, DAG, claim boundary, current synchronized pointers

atlassian.outage_policy: Source work may continue but final state is ATLAS_SYNC_PENDING; cross-plane PASS is forbidden.
